title: Authenticated optimizer profiler
objective: Implement generated Python-to-JavaScript span maps, content-authenticated Node inspector sampling, private route telemetry, profile receipts, and source-attribution/security tests

oracles: Node inspector sampling conservation plus exact source-map and counterfeit-telemetry fixtures

validation: node --test test/optimizer-profile-identity.cjs test/optimizer-profile-source-map.cjs test/optimizer-profile-attribution.cjs test/optimizer-profile-security.cjs test/optimizer-profile-overhead.cjs

runs.command: node --test test/optimizer-profile-identity.cjs test/optimizer-profile-source-map.cjs test/optimizer-profile-attribution.cjs test/optimizer-profile-security.cjs test/optimizer-profile-overhead.cjs

handoff.summary: Implemented canonical compiler-emitted function/loop maps, exact Node Inspector source authentication, independently conserved function-sample and position-tick evidence, non-forgeable lexical route events, frozen receipt assembly, and a cold-run CLI. Focused security/schema/attribution tests pass with about 1.0x median discovery overhead; the full build and compiler suites passed in this worktree. Browser source sampling is explicitly unavailable rather than inferred.
risks: The current evaluator authenticates and maps only the submitted top-level generated script. Work in precompiled or lazy imported modules is conserved as unmatched and must not be presented as source-attributed evidence.
Profile mode measures a cold generated-JavaScript load plus execution; it does not yet provide a prepared warm-code profile protocol.
The repository-wide architecture check reaches the generated opportunity dashboard and reports it stale after the shared lambda identity correction; the dashboard integration lane owns regeneration.
next_steps: Extend runtime-bootstrap module loading with an active-profile-only exact-source recompilation path and an explicit multi-artifact registry; authenticate every module script before attribution and leave ordinary caches untouched.
Regenerate the opportunity dashboard after integrating the shared lambda/profile identity commits, then run the repository-wide architecture check on the integration branch.
Add a separate prepared warm-profile runner so compilation/load time and steady-state execution are never conflated.
